name: quick-actions
description: Quick Actions: icon actions on the text selected in the Claude Code transcript (translate, explain, summarize, find the evidence) and on the conversation itself (recap, decisions, next steps, handoff and more), without a selection through /quick-actions hint. The ones you use most come first (pin your own in settings) and every action is under ⋯, in English or Japanese

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: Comma-separated action IDs to pin at the front of the hint line, in this order (e.g. explain,recap). Actions on the selection and on the conversation (context actions) alike, and the IDs of your customActions too, can go here. The other actions follow in the order you use them, and every action is under ⋯. Leave empty for no pins (the first time: explain,recap,translate,decisions,summarize,code first); unknown IDs are ignored.

hintCount.title: Hint count
hintCount.description: How many actions the hint line shows (a whole number of 1 or more; default 6). The rest are under ⋯. Anything else counts as the default.

customActions.title: Custom actions
customActions.description: JSON array of your own action definitions (see README); target selection (the default) or context. Valid ones join the hint line (in the order you use them) and the ⋯ dialog; put their IDs in actions to pin them at the front. Invalid definitions are ignored with a warning; run /quick-actions to see why.

language.title: Language
language.description: Display and answer language: auto (follow Claude Code's language setting, then the locale; English unless Japanese is detected), ja or en.
